sample_unit: ChatGPT responses to frequently asked questions

links.outcome: Understandability (PEMAT-P) and actionability of ChatGPT responses for families
links.effect: Median PEMAT-P 69.23; only 40% of answers exceeded the understandability threshold and none met the actionability threshold.
links.quote: The median PEMAT-P was 69.23; however, only 40% of answers exceeded the threshold for understandability, and none met actionability threshold.

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ChatGPT responses relative to general public
links.effect: All responses were written at a level exceeding high school, indicating limited readability for the general public.
links.quote: All responses were written at a level exceeding high school, indicating limited readability for the general public.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to frequently asked patient/family questions regarding cerebral palsy for quality, reliability, and readability, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
